item.title: 【Helpdesk】Bulk Download From VIP-Files.Net
item.description:
Does anybody know if there is a way to bulk download from VIP-Files.net (Tez-Files)? rather than individually going through one-by-one.

There are certain artists that I would like to bulk download to save a lot of time.

Tried software like Free Download Manager and JDownloader, but neither work.

Any recommendations or guides/process will be very helpful and appreciated.
